entities.summary: Carlos Ismael Noriega Jiménez is a Peruvian-American NASA employee, a former NASA astronaut and a retired U.S. Marine Corps lieutenant colonel. Carlos became the first Peruvian-born astronaut who went to space. Carlos was born in Lima, Peru and moved to Santa Clara, California in early childhood.
